items.lede: Today, shared Microsoft 365 plans include 1 TB of OneDrive cloud storage for every family member. Microsoft is about to shrink that allotment dramatically.
items.title: Got a Microsoft 365 subscription? Your storage is about to shrink

items.lede: This effectively increases the costs for large users, although it may benefit those who have family members that don't take up much cloud storage space.
items.title: Microsoft 365 slashes storage capacity for shared accounts amid industry-wide shortages

items.lede: What Microsoft giveth, Microsoft taketh away, again and again
items.title: Microsoft 365 subscribers set to lose up to 4TB of OneDrive storage
